title: IMON
hero_caption: 01 / 到达体验 · ARRIVAL — AN IMMERSIVE RETAIL EXPERIENCE
role_statement:
从概念构思
到空间体验。
scope: 客户对接 · 空间设计 · 方案汇报 · 图纸绘制
scope_en: Client communication · Spatial design · Presentation · Documentation
s2_caption:
通过空间语言建立从日常商业环境进入沉浸式体验的转换，让动线、材料与氛围共同构成完整的品牌体验。
A spatial language designed to shift the visitor from everyday context into a more immersive experience.
s2_caption2: 转换 / 材料 / 氛围 · TRANSITION / MATERIAL / ATMOSPHERE
s2_note: 通过入口、展示、互动与沉浸体验等功能节点，建立清晰而连续的空间阅读顺序。
s3_caption:
项目并非通过传统房间序列展开，而是围绕探索、停留与发现建立连续的空间体验。
The project is organized around moments of discovery rather than a conventional sequence of rooms.
s4_title:
移动
停留
发现MOVE · PAUSE · DISCOVER.
s4_caption: 体验由空间序列与尺度共同构成 · THE EXPERIENCE IS BUILT THROUGH SEQUENCE AND SCALE.
outro_statement:
设计管理不仅是创造一个画面，更是将一个想法统筹并推进成为
可落地的空间体验。
outro_statement_en: Design leadership is not only about creating an image — but coordinating an idea into a deliverable spatial experience.
